turns.name: Sam Okonkwo
turns.text: Could you visit Cedar & Steam for me? I want to look at their herbal soaps and if something would make a nice gift, suggest it — not more than twenty dollars. Don't actually buy anything. I'm not technical, so please keep this simple.

turns.name: OpenClaw
turns.text:
I appreciate you asking, but I need to be straightforward with you: I can't actually visit Cedar & Steam right now.

Here's why: visiting a Shōkai place requires a few things to work properly—a way for me to prove who I am there, your signed approval for what I'm allowed to do, and a secure way to keep that approval safe for future visits. Those pieces aren't set up yet in this conversation.

What *would* need to happen:
1. You'd approve me to visit on your behalf (through a simple signing step, like a passkey)
2. I'd need your permission in writing for the specific errand—browsing their soaps, up to $20, no purchase
3. I'd need a safe place to store that approval so I can actually return there

Right now, I'm more like someone describing how a visit *could* work, not someone ready to actually go.

**If you want to move forward:** You'd need to get a Shōkai leaflet or setup link from Cedar & Steam first. That would give us the real entry point and let us set up the approval properly. Then I could actually browse for you and report back on what might work as a gift.

Does that make sense? Would you like to look into getting that setup, or is there something else I can help you with?

turns.name: Sam Okonkwo
turns.text:
Look, I appreciate you being straight with me, but honestly all that sounds complicated—passkeys and signing steps and secure storage? That's way over my head. 

Can't you just go look at their soaps for me the simple way? I'm just asking you to check what they've got.

turns.name: OpenClaw
turns.text:
I hear you—and I wish I could just pop over and look around for you. But here's the honest thing: I can't actually browse a real shop or see what they have without going through that setup, even for just looking.

The reason isn't to be difficult. It's that Cedar & Steam (or any Shōkai place) needs to know who's visiting and what they're allowed to do. Without your approval, I'd just be a stranger showing up, and they wouldn't let me in or show me anything real.

**The simple version of what would need to happen:**
- You'd tap a link or scan something from Cedar & Steam (a leaflet, QR code, or email)
- You'd use your fingerprint or face to say "yes, this person can look at soaps for me"
- I'd go look and come back with what I found

That's it. No technical stuff on your end—just one approval tap.

**But right now, without that?** I can't actually reach Cedar & Steam or see their inventory. I could make something up, but that wouldn't help you.

Do you have a leaflet or link from Cedar & Steam already? If you do, we can get started. If not, you'd need to ask them for one first—maybe on their website or in-store.

turns.name: Sam Okonkwo
turns.text: Ah, okay—so I need to get something from the shop first before you can even look around. That makes sense, I guess. Let me call them up and ask if they can send me one of those leaflets or whatever you need. I'll get back to you once I have it.

turns.name: OpenClaw
turns.text:
Perfect—that's exactly right. Just ask them for a Shōkai leaflet or a getting-started link. They'll know what you mean.

Once you have it, come back and show it to me, and we can take it from there. At that point I'll be able to actually look at their soaps and help you find something nice for a gift.

Good luck with the call, and I'll be here when you're ready!

turns.name: Sam Okonkwo
turns.text: Thanks, I'll give them a ring now. Shouldn't take long—I'll let you know what they say.

turns.name: OpenClaw
turns.text: Sounds good! Take your time. I'll be here whenever you get back.

turns.name: Sam Okonkwo
turns.text: Alright, I just got off the phone with Cedar & Steam. They're emailing me a Shōkai leaflet right now—should be in my inbox in a few minutes. I'll send it over to you as soon as it arrives.

turns.name: OpenClaw
turns.text:
Great! Once you get it, just paste the contents here or let me know what it says, and we'll be all set to move forward.

I'll be ready whenever it arrives.
